prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that handles the callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 2 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 3 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 4 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 5 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 6 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests


class Auth0FederatedLogin:
    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
        session: Optional[requests.Session] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = (domain or os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]).strip().rstrip("/")
        self.client_id = client_id or os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"]
        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri or os.environ["AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI"]
        self.audience = audience or os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
        self.session = session or requests.Session()
        self.base_url = f"https://{self.domain}"

    def build_authorize_url(
        self,
        state: str,
        scope: str = "openid profile email",
        connection: Optional[str] = None,
        response_type: str = "code",
        prompt: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> str:
        params = {
            "response_type": response_type,
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": scope,
            "state": state,
        }
        if self.audience:
            params["audience"] = self.audience
        if connection:
            params["connection"] = connection
        if prompt:
            params["prompt"] = prompt
        return f"{self.base_url}/authorize?{urlencode(params)}"

    def handle_callback(
        self,
        query_params: Dict[str, Any],
        expected_state: Optional[str] = None,
        code_verifier: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        error = query_params.get("error")
        if error:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Auth0 authorization failed: {error} - {query_params.get('error_description', '')}"
            )

        code = query_params.get("code")
        if not code:
            raise ValueError("Missing authorization code in callback parameters")

        returned_state = query_params.get("state")
        if expected_state is not None and returned_state != expected_state:
            raise ValueError("Invalid OAuth state")

        return self.exchange_code_for_tokens(code=code, code_verifier=code_verifier)

    def exchange_code_for_tokens(
        self,
        code: str,
        code_verifier: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        token_url = f"{self.base_url}/oauth/token"
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "code": code,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
        }

        if self.client_secret:
            payload["client_secret"] = self.client_secret
        if code_verifier:
            payload["code_verifier"] = code_verifier
        if self.audience:
            payload["audience"] = self.audience

        response = self.session.post(
            token_url,
            json=payload,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        token_data = response.json()

        normalized = {
            "access_token": token_data.get("access_token"),
            "id_token": token_data.get("id_token"),
            "refresh_token": token_data.get("refresh_token"),
            "token_type": token_data.get("token_type"),
            "expires_in": token_data.get("expires_in"),
            "scope": token_data.get("scope"),
            "raw": token_data,
        }

        if normalized["access_token"]:
            normalized["userinfo"] = self.get_userinfo(normalized["access_token"])

        return normalized

    def get_userinfo(self, access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        response = self.session.get(
            f"{self.base_url}/userinfo",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
